This change will improve code readability and avoid potential issues in long strings.  The current implementation uses a technique called 'type erasure', where the type information is lost at compile-time, making it harder to detect typos and unexpected behavior. By using `std::string`, we can maintain better control over the string's lifetime and ensure thread-safety.  This change will also simplify our test suite by reducing dependencies on the specific `wstring` implementation used in our current codebase.
